title: federal reserve / fomc / monetary policy implementation | Fomc Statement | Implementation Note issued June 16, 2021
summary: The Federal Reserve's Implementation Note dated June 16, 2021 describes the operational mechanics for implementing the FOMC's monetary policy stance. The Board of Governors unanimously set the interest rate on required and excess reserve balances at 0.15 percent, and the FOMC directed the Desk to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 0 to 1/4 percent while conducting $80 billion per month in Treasury purchases and $40 billion per month in agency MBS purchases.
